title: Tempo day colours since 2014-2015 (daily dataset)
description:
Daily colour (blue, white or red) of the French Tempo electricity tariff since 1 September 2014: one line per day with date (YYYY-MM-DD), colour (bleu, blanc, rouge) and Tempo season (1 September to 31 August). A Tempo day runs from 06:00 to 06:00, Paris time.

Source: colours set and published by RTE, the French transmission system operator (API Tempo Like Supply Contract, data.rte-france.com), read several times a day and compiled by Jour Tempo. Each version is a snapshot of the file at the release date; the live file is updated every day at https://jourtempo.fr/api/v1/tempo-historique.csv (free API, no key).

Credit when reusing: "Couleurs Tempo : RTE, via Jour Tempo (https://jourtempo.fr)". Jour Tempo is independent from EDF and RTE. Contact: contact@jourtempo.fr
